text.description_html:
Deltana ZHP70 Hinge Pin Door Stop

This universal fit door stop is mounted on a door hinge pin instead of on the floor or baseboard. Easily adjustable, simple to use, out of the way and out of sight.

Universal fit - for use with most common sized door hinges (3.5" x 3.5", 4" x 4" and 4.5" x 4.5" door hinges). They work with all hinges that have a hinge pin of 5/16" diameter or less.

The door opening adjustment range is approximately from 90 degrees to 140 degrees. Note that the thickness of the jamb moulding and the distance of the hinge pin from the door face will affect the adjustment range for each application.

Specifications for Deltana ZHP70 Hinge Pin Door Stop

  • Hinge Pin Diameter: 5/16" and smaller (Includes a 1/4" diameter reducer bushing)
  • Door Opening Range: 90 - 140 Degrees, Approximate
  • Material: Zinc
  • Rubber Bumpers: 9/16" Diameter, Gray Rubber
  • Easy to Install
  • Available Finishes: 7
  • Deltana HP70 Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually.
